To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Direct Taylor Series Error Estimate, the Moment Error Estimate and the Local Resential Problem Error Estimate can be used to estimate the solution error in the Finite Volume method.

the Direct Taylor Series Error estimation method is a reliable method of error estimation, that the Moment Error method is a useful tool for error estimation in steady state incompressible flows, that the Residual Error estimate gives good results for steady state compressible and transient problems and that the Adaptive Mesh Refinement algorithm can be used to produce a solution of required accuracy.

the analysis of numerical errors and the development of methods to estimate and control them.

the proposed methods of error analysis and estimation are accurate, reliable and easy to implement.

the proposed method of error estimation is very accurate and robust.
